notes: English synopsis: author page 7 continues a discussion of a path l serving as an origin element. A Mordell-Weil paragraph is cancelled before its sentence is completed. The live text compares paths l and l′ and gives the right/left cocycle transformation formulas (31), their inverse form, and cohomology classes (32). It ends with an outer-isomorphism arrow and a long sloping marginal claim that the construction requires only the completed fundamental groupoid and is independent of transcendental considerations and the choice of complex base field.

Page numbering: large manuscript 7 at top centre; thin grey 78 at lower right. No printed numbering was found. The large upright (32) belongs to the displayed two-row formula; the note contains a separate small sloping (32) after cohomologie.

Authorial caveats and slips retained: the Mordell-Weil paragraph is cancelled and unfinished; et puis remplace is grammatically awkward but visually supported; final diagram has Y,y where the context suggests X,y. No expected mathematical text was supplied.

Independent reading workflow: reader_c viewed only assigned scan 079, the whole once and each native half once, with C and H. Eight distinct open places received one crop each. The marginal crop was revisited without recropping. No OCR, web, source-text layer, TeX compilation, or other page was used.

Crop limitations: scan079_isom_phrase.jpg clips upper portions of the words at its right because the source baseline rises; the full native bottom-half view supplies those forms. No replacement crop was made. Marginal boxes identify source-image regions; the shared rotated crop is the review image for those overlapping lines.

Root review received after the independent visual findings: root likewise preferred the deleted {}^u a·a^{-1} with low confidence, a retraced live g rather than cancellation under H¹, enfin at medium confidence, and the large upright (32) as display label. These are corroborating review messages, not independent mathematical proof events.

Mathematical verification was limited to conditional local algebra of (31) and its inverse, described in the actual check event below. The Mordell-Weil claim, cocycle assertions, construction of outer isomorphisms, and independence caveat were transcribed, not proved. Cited earlier formulas (10),(11) were not consulted.

Main reader adjudication: all reported witness differences and open places were checked on their saved crops, including the 17 additional review crops; the complete element inventory was compared with the page layout and proposed transcription. Remaining obscured wording is deliberately marked as undecided. The clear Y in the last diagram is retained; no mathematical correction has been substituted for it.

An isolated nearly vertical pen stroke stands immediately to the right of the cancelled Mordell-Weil paragraph. It is shown in inline TikZ because its visible shape is distinct; its function is uncertain. It has no lower dot, and no exclamation mark or letter is supplied. The archive folio 78 remains in the transcription and inventory but is excluded from substantive C/H difference counts as a page-marker issue.
